t: When wearing $(item)Soulstrider's armor$(), a magical botanist can feel dark energy surging in them. While this armor can be repaired like its $(l:items/sky_armor)counterparts$(), it also provides a $(thing)set bonus$(): When wearing every piece of the armor (or swapping the chestplate for an $(item)Elytra$()), upon being struck, the armor causes all nearby enemies to fuse with the ground for a few seconds, causing them to $(thing)stand completely still$().
穿上$(item)灵魂行者盔甲$()时，魔法植物学家能感到黑暗能量在体内涌动。这套盔甲与它的$(l:items/sky_armor)同类$()一样可以修复，此外还带$(thing)套装效果$()：穿齐全套（或把胸甲换成$(item)鞘翅$()）后，一旦受到攻击，盔甲会让附近所有敌人与地面融为一体数秒，使它们$(thing)完全无法动弹$()。
